user.title: TS1201 IR Remote
user.description: Control a confirmed air-conditioner codebook and manage the named IR keys stored by your TS1201 ZHA quirk. You can add this panel before pairing the device. Setup sends no infrared commands.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one TS1201 IR panel is needed.
